figures.caption: Raw gene-assigned library counts and detected genes for all seven samples. Each bar is one biological sample; FA n=4, PM n=3. No sample was excluded.

PCA of the 500 highest-variance genes after DESeq2 variance stabilization; genes were mean-centered, without variance scaling. Each point is a biological sample. Sample separation is descriptive and does not establish a biological mechanism or batch effect.

Left: Spearman correlation of DESeq2-normalized counts across the retained genes. Right: Euclidean distances using all variance-stabilized retained genes. Both panels use the same sample order obtained by average-linkage clustering of 1-rho. Group colors supplement explicit FA/PM labels.

Mean normalized abundance versus effect estimate. Orange/teal points are significant increases/decreases at BH FDR <0.05; grey genes do not meet this threshold. Dashed lines indicate an exploratory absolute log2 effect of one. Shrinkage does not alter Wald p-values or BH adjusted p-values.

Volcano plot uses the selected effect estimate on the x-axis and the unmodified two-sided Wald BH-adjusted p-value on the y-axis. Genes with missing adjusted p-values are omitted from this panel and retained as NA in the full table. Six smallest adjusted p-values are labelled; labels do not imply replication.

Thirty genes ranked by adjusted p-value, followed by raw p-value, shown after variance stabilization and within-gene mean centering / sample SD scaling. Fixed sample order FA1-FA4, PM1-PM3. This selection is outcome-dependent and descriptive; included genes are not necessarily all significant.

Preselected genes Gfap and Ahr, when available. Each labelled point is one biological sample; black lines show group means. Counts are divided by DESeq2 size factors. The displayed FDR comes from the genome-wide comparison, not a separate gene-specific test.
